prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for sign_in/reorder, finish/notification, and choose_path/layout is still thin as each has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Temperament Quiz Sub-Flow: Insert a 2-question interactive temperament quiz screen during adoption to help users select pet traits. (why: Adoption has a low 60.9% completion rate and median time of 89s; guiding personality setup builds emotional connection.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostics Screen: Add a desktop render verification screen following pet creation to test screen overlay permissions. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop, and home waiting time averages 201s median.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Save Security Reassurance Banner: Display a hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that authentication preserves and syncs their adopted pets. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after logging in again, showing major user concern over sign-in account safety.)
3: [adoption, layout] Certificate Customization Split View: Change the adoption certificate screen to a split view layout with live preview side-by-side with pet naming. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% and support received reports of custom pet setup confusion.)
4: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Generation Progress Feed: Enable progress bar, time estimates, and a dynamic tip carousel while pet assets render during the waiting step. (why: The waiting step has a long median delay of 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to abandon before initialization completes.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Companion Creation Time Estimate Copy: Add clear time estimates to the path selection screen comparing instant pre-made pets versus custom creation. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s, indicating uncertainty around how long each creation path will take.)

scores.note: Adoption has the largest user drop (39.1%), but adding a multi-screen sub-flow increases friction.
Backed by 3 support emails and long home wait times, but requires building a full diagnostic screen.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign_in drop; cheap banner implementation.
Adoption needs help and support mentions confusion, but layout changes previously showed negative lift.
Directly targets massive 201s/2336s waiting delay to prevent drop-off during asset generation.
Low-cost copy change to resolve high mean time spent selecting a creation path.
